Five new modules. The fourteen from v0.2.1 are included unchanged.

**New modules**
- `html-to-text.wasm`: HTML emails, pages and rich-text fields to clean text or Markdown, keeping headings, lists, tables and links
- `key-value-extractor.wasm`: labeled values ("Invoice No:", "Total Due") and aligned tables from document text, typed as numbers, amounts or dates, with anything not found listed for review
- `log-parser.wasm`: Apache/nginx access logs, syslog (RFC 3164 and 5424), key=value and JSON log lines into records, detected line by line
- `uom-converter.wasm`: quantities between units of measure and your own pack sizes (case, box, pallet), chained as needed
- `address-standardizer.wasm`: US and Canadian addresses standardized USPS-style (suffixes, directions, units, states, ZIP and postal codes) and country names to ISO codes; it formats addresses and does not verify them

**How releases are built**
- Every file is built on x86-64 Linux from the tagged source on GitHub, after the unit tests and the contract check pass. Rebuilding this tag with `./build.sh` gives byte-identical files; compare with `SHA256SUMS`.
- Each file has a signed build provenance attestation: `gh attestation verify <file> --repo neblexhq/neblex-wasm-modules`.

Modules are 60 to 175 KB.
